say:1:1821332001:0.text: "I used to be a frail and sickly child. Every day, I walked that same path with my mother, mile by mile."
say:1:1821332001:0.source_cn: “儿时的我，体弱多病，每天跟随妈妈走过那条熟悉的路。”

say:2:1821332002:0.text: "We always went to her little apothecary. Its doors would open, then close once more, welcoming in the weary souls."
say:2:1821332002:0.source_cn: “路的尽头，是妈妈开设的药铺；店门开了又关，里面尽是愁...

say:3:1821332003:0.text: "Their tired eyes would light up with joy, smiling at me with all their might. I'd wave goodbye as they walked away, not knowing why some couldn't stay."
say:3:1821332003:0.source_cn: “他们的眼中满是风雨，却向小小的我投来鼓励；我学会了与...

say:4:1821332004:0.text: "Mom, what happened to that kind old man? And what about that cheerful lady? How come she never came back?"
say:4:1821332004:0.source_cn: “妈妈啊，那个爷爷去哪了？那个爱笑的阿姨，怎么再也没来过？”

say:5:1821332005:0.text: "Mom drew me into her arms so warm, her gentle voice like shelter from the storm: 'Some farewells lead to sweeter encounters, waiting for us, just around the corner.'"
say:5:1821332005:0.source_cn: “妈妈轻轻抱着我，声音随晚风而去：孩子，有些别离，是为...

say:6:1821332006:0.text: "Maybe they've gone to a land so bright, where pain and sickness fade from sight. They're waiting for us on that distant shore, until the day we meet once more."
say:6:1821332006:0.source_cn: “也许他们走过了风雨，去到一个不用吃药的地方；也许他们...

say:7:1821332007:0.text: "From then on, I feared goodbyes no more. Mom taught me that every ending holds something more."
say:7:1821332007:0.source_cn: “所以我学会了不再害怕再见，因为妈妈说过离别不是终点。”

say:8:1821332008:0.text: "That's something we'll all come to understand for sure..."
say:8:1821332008:0.source_cn: “总有一天，我们都会明白：有些别离，是为了更好的相聚……”

say:12:1821332011:1.text: As the song comes to an end, the children sit so captivated that not one of them stirs.
say:12:1821332011:1.source_cn: 一曲唱罢，孩子们沉浸在塞涅的歌声中，竟无人回神。

say:13:1821332012:1.text: S-Senea... has such a wonderful voice...
say:13:1821332012:1.source_cn: 塞……塞涅姐姐唱歌真好听……

say:16:1821332014:1.text: Some farewells lead to sweeter encounters... Hmm... I guess that's true. After all, I got to meet Senea here.
say:16:1821332014:1.source_cn: 别离是为了更好的相聚……就像，我在这里遇到了塞涅姐姐……

say:17:1821332015:1.text: Brunno, saying goodbye to the living is never easy. But now, you've found us. Undor and Lilli also passed away when they were your age, so they know how helpless and frightened you feel.
say:17:1821332015:1.source_cn: 布鲁诺，你虽与生者告别，却与身为亡者的我们相遇。你身边...

say:18:1821332016:1.text: With everyone's support, they grew stronger and became who they are today. It took them centuries, but they made it.
say:18:1821332016:1.source_cn: 但在大家的帮助下，他们用了几个世纪的时间，成长为你现在...

say:19:1821332017:1.text: And you can do the same. It's normal to fear death, as it means you still long to live. Now, you just need time to get used to a different way of existing.
say:19:1821332017:1.source_cn: 那么，你也可以做到同样的事情。你对死亡感到恐惧，恰巧能...

say:20:1821332018:1.text: You have all the time in the world to figure it out. It took me a few months to get the hang of life here, but I'm sure you'll adapt even faster than I did.
say:20:1821332018:1.source_cn: 但你有几乎无限的时间来探索。我花了几个月的时间才适应亡...

say:21:1821332019:1.text: The day you graduate from here, I'll put on a show in your honor.
say:21:1821332019:1.source_cn: 等你能够从孤儿院毕业的那天，我会为你献上一场演出，以表庆贺。

say:22:1821332020:1.text: Can you promise me you'll keep working toward that day?
say:22:1821332020:1.source_cn: 可以和我约定吗，布鲁诺？

say:24:1821332022:1.text: Senea, you're such a good singer. Your voice... makes me feel calmer.
say:24:1821332022:1.source_cn: 塞涅姐姐，你唱歌真好听。不知道为什么……我好像也没那么...

say:25:1821332023:1.text: Music has a way of soothing the soul. It's how I express myself best.
say:25:1821332023:1.source_cn: 音乐天然具备抚慰人心的力量，这也是我最擅长的表达方式。

say:26:1821332024:1.text: Could you... sing another song for me?

say:28:1821332026:1.text: And, Mr. Magician... c-could I see that beautiful star trick again?
say:28:1821332026:1.male: And, Mr. Magician... c-could I see that beautiful star trick again?
say:28:1821332026:1.female: And, Miss Magician... c-could I see that beautiful star trick again?

choice_prompt:29:1821332026.text: And, Mr. Magician... c-could I see that beautiful star trick again?
choice_prompt:29:1821332026.source_cn: 还有这位<male>大哥哥</male><female>大姐姐</female>……我，我还想看你变那个特别漂亮的星星。可以……吗？
choice_prompt:29:1821332026.male: And, Mr. Magician... c-could I see that beautiful star trick again?
choice_prompt:29:1821332026.female: And, Miss Magician... c-could I see that beautiful star trick again?

say:30:1821332027:1.text: You're so nice! I think... I feel a little better now. I'm really glad I got to meet you and Senea!
say:30:1821332027:1.source_cn: 谢谢你！我……我好像明白一点了。能遇到你和塞涅姐姐，真好！
say:30:1821332027:1.male: You're so nice! I think... I feel a little better now. I'm really glad I got to meet you and Senea!
say:30:1821332027:1.female: You're so nice! I think... I feel a little better now. I'm really glad I got to meet you and Senea!

narration:31:1821332028:1.text: You and Senea spend some time playing with the children before leaving under their reluctant gazes.
narration:31:1821332028:1.male: You and Senea spend some time playing with the children before leaving under their reluctant gazes.
narration:31:1821332028:1.female: You and Senea spend some time playing with the children before leaving under their reluctant gazes.

choice:29:1:2.text: Magic is meant to bring joy.
choice:29:1:2.source_cn: 魔法就是用来让人开心的
choice:29:1:2.male: Magic is meant to bring joy.
choice:29:1:2.female: Magic is meant to bring joy.
